:::note[Covers what is coming]
This page also covers a few things that are newer than HotLoop Cascade 1.2.1, the latest release. Parts of it may not be in what you have installed. The [release notes](/releases/) say what moved.
:::

## What this is

0.1.2 is a build fix and nothing else. The code is the same as 0.1.1, and so is everything you run: the chart, the Quadlet units, the settings, the database.

Cascade is built and published on Podman the whole way through now, and the image holds exactly amd64 and arm64.

## Upgrading from 0.1.1

Nothing to do. `helm upgrade` to 0.1.2, or let `:stable` roll the Quadlet units. No migrations, no new settings, and the key and your workflows stay where they were.
